comment: The paved brick turnout between the road line and the planting/fence on the right.

Road surface just below the near-side median curb closest to the red/white chevron post.
Road-edge paving on the near side of the tall black lamp on the right.

Road immediately behind the rear of the white Toyota pickup with metal cage.
